title: Pocari Sweat Run Bandung 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Pocari Sweat Run Bandung 2026 Review | West Java
meta_description: Pocari Sweat Run Bandung 2026 review: 16,000 runners over two days from Balai Kota on 19-20 September, the route, and how the roads were shared.
dek: Pocari Sweat Run ran its ninth Bandung edition over 19 and 20 September 2026, with 16,000 runners across two days. Here is what it was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: Pocari Sweat Run Bandung is a big, polished city race, and it knows its city: the 2026 edition was the ninth in Bandung [1]. It put 7,600 runners on the roads for the 10 km on Saturday 19 September and 8,400 for the half marathon on Sunday 20 September, both from Balai Kota Bandung [1]. The half-marathon route is a full tour of the city, from Dago through Asia Afrika and back [2]. The one thing to know before you enter is that the roads are not fully closed. Traffic is diverted and road space is shared with other users [2]. If you want a big, well-supported race with a lot of spectators, it delivers. Just run it knowing there will be vehicles nearby.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition in Numbers
paragraphs: The 2026 Bandung edition drew 16,000 runners across two race days: 7,600 in the 10 km on Saturday 19 September and 8,400 in the half marathon on Sunday 20 September [1]. Both started and finished at Balai Kota Bandung, the city hall [1][2].

It was the ninth year of the race in Bandung, and it was part of the city's 216th anniversary celebrations [1]. With the Lombok edition in July and a virtual edition, the 2026 Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia series drew 56,559 runners from 439 cities [1].

sections.heading: The Route and the Roads
paragraphs: The 10 km ran between 4.45am and 7am, from Jalan Perintis Kemerdekaan through Wastukencana, Ir H Juanda to a turnaround on Teuku Umar, then Dago, Diponegoro, RE Martadinata and Merdeka back to the finish [2]. The half marathon ran from 4am to 8am on a much longer loop through Dago, Supratman, A Yani, Kiaracondong, Gatot Subroto, Asia Afrika, Pasir Kaliki and Pajajaran before returning to Balai Kota [2].

Mayor Muhammad Farhan said there would be no full road closures: traffic was managed by diversions and by sharing road space with other users [2]. Afterwards he thanked residents for supporting runners along the route [1], and the organiser said the race is reviewed each year with the city, the police and running communities so that it runs well without ignoring residents [1].

sections.heading: Waste, and the Crowd
paragraphs: The 2026 race ran under a zero-waste-to-landfill commitment, with the Pandawara Group community running the route and picking up rubbish, which was sent for sorting and recycling with the city's environment agency [1].
Singer Rizky Febian, who ran his first race in the 10 km, said the residents' enthusiasm was incredible and made the atmosphere warm and festive [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a large Indonesian city race with a proper half-marathon route and a lot of support on the roadside, yes. Nine editions in Bandung show in the logistics, and the two-day format means the 10 km and half marathon fields do not share the road.
Go in knowing the roads are shared, not closed [2]. Stay in your lane, and run the 4am half marathon with something reflective.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran Pocari Sweat Run Bandung 2026?
faqs.answer: 16,000 runners over two days: 7,600 in the 10 km on Saturday 19 September 2026 and 8,400 in the half marathon on Sunday 20 September, both from Balai Kota Bandung. It was the ninth Bandung edition, part of the city's 216th anniversary celebrations.

faqs.question: Are the roads closed for Pocari Sweat Run Bandung?
faqs.answer: Not fully. For 2026 the mayor said there would be no full road closures: traffic was managed by diversions and by sharing road space with other road users. The half marathon ran between 4am and 8am and the 10 km between 4.45am and 7am.

faqs.question: What is the Pocari Sweat Run Bandung half-marathon route?
faqs.answer: In 2026 it started on Jalan Perintis Kemerdekaan by Balai Kota and looped through Dago, Diponegoro, Supratman, A Yani, Kiaracondong, Gatot Subroto, Asia Afrika, Jenderal Sudirman, Pasir Kaliki and Pajajaran before finishing back at Balai Kota.
